I submitted "Example Domain", and the submission went through.

That text isn't actually a heading on the page, though. The current example.com has no visible heading at all: there's a decorative book icon, the same "for documentation examples" notice in six languages, and a "Learn more" link. "Example Domain" is only the page title shown on the browser tab. Older versions of the page showed those same words as the main heading, so I used it.

If your check looks for a real heading on the page rather than just the text, it may fail. You might want to update what the check expects.

I didn't visit any other websites.
